Where is Bhava Bala in Vedaansh?

Long image

A

Answer

Open a chart → Bhava Bala tab. The engine writes chart.bhavaBala on every full calculate; the UI shows twelve house totals in Rupas.

  1. Sidenav and chart tabs both expose bhava-bala.1
  2. calculateChart runs calculateBhavaBala after Shadbala.2
  3. Formula: Adhipati + Digbala + Drishti; totalRupa = totalShash / 60.3
  4. Strong flag: totalRupa >= 7.5 (450 Virupas, Raman floor).3

2

What does the engine compute?

Diagram structure
  • Adhipati adip
  • Digbala dig
  • Drishti dri
  • totalRupa tot
  • adip → dig
  • dig → dri
  • dri → tot · / 60
  1. Adhipati ↗

    Sign lord’s total Shadbala (Virupas) for the house Rashi.

  2. Digbala ↗

    Sign category vs zero-kendra; arc ÷ 3, max 60.

  3. Drishti ↗

    Sputa aspects on equal-house cusp; Ju/Me full; others ±¼; Ra/Ke out.

  4. totalRupa ↗

    (adhipati + dig + drishti) / 60; isStrong if ≥ 7.5.
